title: The Stories of Sherlock Holmes
identity_notes: South African Springbok Radio Sherlock Holmes series produced by Michael Silver, starring Graham Armitage as Sherlock Holmes and Kerry Jordan as Dr. Watson. Specialist reference describes 47 or 50 episodes and explicitly warns that listed dates are not fully verified. Frozen GRH subset contains 18 archive objects, including one exact duplicate-audio pair under conflicting Crouch End/Kraut End labels.

eras.label: Springbok Radio run
eras.notes: Specialist reference gives 1979/1980-1985 range and Sunday 6 PM broadcasts.
